lifecycleScripts.afterStart: bash -c 'set -e; npx wp-env --config=.wp-env.multisite.json run cli wp site option update registration user; npx wp-env --config=.wp-env.multisite.json run cli wp option add users_can_register 0 || true; npx wp-env --config=.wp-env.multisite.json run cli wp plugin activate wp-approve-user --network'
